Note: AutoSplitKey is wired to BC's own NavForm.SplitKey, but the runner supplies no InsertLowerBoundBookmark, so an empty grid's first line computes 10000 where real BC (27.5 and 28.3 alike) assigns 20000. The rest of this codeunit — that the action saves the row before OnAction at all, that a plain SetValue does not, and that a page without AutoSplitKey leaves Line No. at 0 — passes and must keep passing; that is the #1725 fix.

Same one-interval offset as the entry above: the runner numbers an empty grid 10000/20000/30000 where real BC numbers it 20000/30000/40000. The increment and the ordering are already right — only the starting interval is not.

A new line appended to a grid already holding a line at 50000 lands at 10000 instead of 60000 — the runner never positions the insert at the end of the rowset, so SplitKey computes from a null lower bound. Not a duplicate-key bug (SplitKey's collision fallback still avoids that), but a line inserted before the existing ones rather than after them.
